newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Switches in dollars and yen.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Switches in dollars and yen.

text.p: Bond analysts' latest Eurobond trade ideas featured the dollar, yen, lira and mark.

In Euroyen, Sanwa International recommends switching to Export-Import Bank of Japan's 2.875 percent July 2005 bond from Italy's 3.75 percent bond due June 2005. Export-Import Bank has a lower coupon than the Italy bond and can be bought at a discount to par whilst Italy can be sold at a premium to par.
**Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters**
BUY Export-Import Bank of Japan 2.875 percent 07/05

STRATEGY This move into a bond with higher credit offers a yield give-up of 7 b.p. This is the best available in the last six months with there being an average yield loss of 18 basis points and a low of 28.5 b.p.
BUY Commonwealth Bank of Australia 6.625 percent 07/99
STRATEGY This ratings neutral trade maintains sovereign exposure as CBA is guaranteed by the Commonwealth of Australia.
It offers a yield pick-up of 11 b.p. while dropping 0.2 years in duration.
STRATEGY This trade offers a pick-up of around 32 b.p. and beats the curve by 26 b.p.
STRATAGY This move from a corporate issue to a government guaranteed issue offers a pick up in rating, an 8 b.p. pick-up in yield and beats the curve by 6 b.p.
To follow are a series of switches:
STRATEGY Bank Austria offers a higher rating and around a 10 b.p. pick-up in yield. Against the swap it is cheaper at 24 b.p. through, compared with 34 b.p. through for Sweden.
STRATEGY This switch offers around a 12 b.p. pick-up for a slightly shorter duration. Rabobank is cheaper to swap at 18 b.p. through, whilst EBRD is at 32 b.p. through.

STRATEGY Credit Local ofers around an 11 b.p. pick-up in yield and is cheaper againt the swap and BTP at 16 b.p. and 4 b.p. through respectively compared with KFW which is expensive at 28 b.p. through the swap.
STRATEGY This switch gives a 44 b.p. pick-up, a six-month high. The low was 25 b.p. and the average was 32 b.p.
